evidence_class: Offline unit checks of the recipe with Docker mocked (our integration checks, not upstream tests), plus read-only host observations: registry byte hashes of the pinned proxy image, one pull by digest, image identity checks, one selected-field inspect of the default bridge network, the credential inventory tests and the value-free credential status. No attempt network or container was created and no gateway or model request was made. Entries 21-24 were added after review at commit 34d43059: the validate workflow's read-only check commands and the full unit suite, run inside an unprivileged user and network namespace whose only interface was loopback with nothing listening, so no TCP or UDP traffic could leave it. The namespace does not isolate path-based unix sockets, such as the rootless Docker daemon's or the user bus; the Docker CLI was not on PATH, and owned containers and networks were 0 afterwards. A base-versus-head control covers every check that failed.
sanitization: The worktree prefix is shown as <worktree>, the scratch directory as <scratch>, the unit TMPDIR as <tmpdir> inside outputs, and the home directory as ~ or $HOME. The module prefix `tests.test_runtime_worker_openhands.` is dropped from test names. Red and failed-attempt outputs are excerpts: the summary lines, each non-ok test with its count of non-ok lines (subtests) when above one, and each distinct first exception line with its count, cut at 220 characters; tracebacks are omitted, and rerunning the command on the named tree reproduces them. Green outputs keep the summary lines. Host outputs keep only the lines this record cites; the network ID is truncated and other credential rows are omitted.
decisions: Coordinator amendment of 2026-09-28: build the phase-2 plan's section 1 (isolation design) and items E1, E2, E3 and E5; E4 (resolver mode) goes to a follow-up PR. Fail closed if network create rejects gateway mode isolated. P3-P5 are documented steps and a skeleton, not run. No push, rebase, manifests/evidence.json change, container, network or gateway request.
